name: sapling-wasm
description: Sapling Wasm workspace for Taquito and compatible consumers.
author: ECAD Labs Inc <info@ecadlabs.com>

scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/sapling-wasm/node_modules packages/sapling-wasm/dist packages/sapling-wasm/pkg packages/sapling-wasm/pkg-web
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:repo && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked --manifest-path packages/sapling/Cargo.toml && npm run test:rust:warnings && npm run test:rust:wasm-warnings
scripts.test:rust:wasm-warnings: RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check --locked --manifest-path packages/sapling/Cargo.toml --features wasm_bindings --quiet
